issues.description: step-8a is stuck in loading state - never renders the result screen with AI-redesigned room image or before/after slider
issues.root_cause: The step-8a page appears to be perpetually in a loading state. The render processing never completes or the result data is never received, so it never transitions to showing the redesigned room image and before/after slider.

issues.description: step-3/page.tsx has duplicate React hook imports causing a module build failure: 'useEffect' and 'useState' are defined multiple times
issues.root_cause: The file has two import lines from 'react': line 2 imports { useState, useEffect } and line 4 imports { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState }, causing a compile error: 'the name useEffect is defined multiple times' and 'the name useState is defined multiple times'.

fixes.old_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: The source file shown already has the correct single import line. The error logs show there were TWO import lines. Ensure only this single consolidated import exists and remove any duplicate import line below it.

fixes.old_str:
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
fixes.new_str:
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
fixes.reason: Verify there is no stale duplicate import line between these two lines. The build error shows a second import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react' was present. This consolidates to one clean import.
